items.q: Goodman on clarinet, Lionel Hampton on vibes

ctx.x: And even in his quartet, when he had Lionel Hampton. I should mention Goodman on clarinet, but Goodman on clarinet, Lionel Hampton on vibes, Teddy Wilson on bass, Sid Bernstein on --
No, Sid Bernstein on bass and Teddy Wilson on piano.
